modificationDescription: Barrel re-export hand-rebuilt by cross-referencing the built .d.mts/.mjs output; the original upstream barrel was a pure re-export the sourcemap does not capture as a separately-mapped file.

Manually transcribed from the tarball's dist/types.d.mts declaration file (dist/types.mjs.map has empty sources, so extract-source.mjs recovers nothing for it); StyleType was deliberately narrowed from upstream's real union type and the @primeuix/styled import was stripped, per this file's own header comment.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-button* class-name string literals renamed to .u-button* (including the sibling .p-badge reference used for button badges, renamed to .u-badge) to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-checkbox* class-name string literals renamed to .u-checkbox* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Generic shared-state selectors (.p-disabled, .p-invalid, .p-variant-filled) left unrenamed, consistent with the base module's own treatment of framework-level classes.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-dialog* class-name string literals renamed to .u-dialog* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Generic shared selector (.p-resizable-handle) and @keyframes identifiers left unrenamed, consistent with the base module's own treatment of framework-level classes.
